name: session-retrospective
title: Session retrospective
description: Use this skill when asked to learn from, retrospect on, review, or extract lessons from a difficult agent session without jumping straight to creating a new skill.
do-not-use-when: Reviewing an external artefact such as a website, docs page, repo, or skill collection — use project-learn-from-source instead
Reviewing recurring entries already captured in the friction log — use friction-review instead
when: When extracting lessons from a difficult agent session
triggers: what should we learn from this
what can we learn from that session
